subject.title: fix: reconcile timed-out gateway message actions

question: Is same-process message-action reconciliation acceptable even though a gateway restart during the ambiguous delivery window can still permit a duplicate send?
rationale: Source proves the same-key join and cache behavior within one gateway process, but deciding whether that lifecycle guarantee is sufficient requires maintainer ownership of the delivery risk.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Merge after a delayed real-channel run proves exactly one visible delivery, and track restart-durable idempotency separately.

options.title: Require restart durability
options.body: Pause until message-action idempotency survives gateway restarts or the reconciliation call cannot redispatch.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Merge after a delayed real-channel run proves exactly one visible delivery, and track restart-durable idempotency separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway client, timeout, and message-action history makes this the strongest available decision owner.
